question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Five Point Someone’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chetan Bhagat.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Chetan Baghat, a rising star in the contemporary modern Indian literature, is a multitalented personality.
 
• He is a novelist, columnist, public speaker and a screenplay writer.
 
• H**is notable works include Five Point Someone, The 3 Mistakes of My Life and 2 States**.
 
• Chetan Bhagat's 'Five Point Someone' is a story about **three friends and four years in IIT**. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73865631d04d564ff09f6e71613fc4ab677b70515734ffe25de21d3a9d4d3c3d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Durjoy Datta** is an Indian author and screenwriter known for his coffee-table novels about the romantic life of young Indians. 
 
• **Ravinder Singh** is an Indian software engineer and author of nine novels**.**
 
• **Amish Tripathi** __is an Indian author. He is known for his book series **Shiva Trilogy and Ram Chandra Series.**
